title: Seeking Motivated Young Actors
author: Corey Ralston

body:
I have taught a bonkers amount of classes to young actors in my life. Some were broad in topic and some were extremely dialed into a niche. There have been magical classes, where the students were an utter joy to teach and I wept on the last day of class. Then, you know there were others that had me wanting to fake a migraine. It happens.

What I have developed this past year that I am so extremely proud of is a behometh of a course I call THE CRAFT. It started out as a 12 week class that was expanded to 16 weeks. Most recently it ran a total of 20 weeks. And this new upcoming session is 22 weeks!

I designed it for serious kid actors ages 11 and up. It covers everything you need to know to go out in the world and pursue a professional career in acting like a prepared, savvy artist. From acting methods by Uta Hagen, Stella Adler, Sanford Meisner, Strasberg, Stanislavski and more - to making choices in your audition sides that get callbacks. It is a challenging intensive that demands every student is a driven, talented and eager to learn.

The transformation that I have witnessed in every student who has completed the course is astounding. They connect with characters and invest in scenes quickly and deeply. They make smart choices and have an awareness of their worth and a strategy in their backpocket. It is really humbling to experience.

Each Craft student receives a detailed evaluation of their skill, notes on their growth, observations on their personality and recommendations to further develop them as actors. During the course they also get audition feedback as a bonus and two free private coaching sessions. At the end of the course they will also have a demo clip script ready to shoot that is coached and crafted to showcase their best in a particular genre.

Only offered to a select group of actors twice a year - this one opportunity to not miss.

Apply Here

Applications are open right now and a video link is required to see if they are on the level yet to get the most out of this course. Because of popularity I have offered this course simultaneously, two days a week to maximize the kids that are eager and qualified to take it.

Graduates of the course are reporting an increase in callbacks because of confident, smart choices. And some have already booked supporting & Leads in Feature Films, Guest Stars on Series and even a Series Regular job.

You can read more about the topics adressed in the course and pricing for the opportunity HERE.

Learn more

Because I believe in this course so much I have limited number of partial scholarships available to make sure no one is left out simply because of their financial standings. If they have the talent and the motivation - I want to help them succeed. Email for more info on those limited spaces.
